items.name: dsh-reasoning-only-guard
items.desc: Keeps one reasoning-only turn from making an entire session unusable. When a turn produces no visible text and no tool call, the assistant message is persisted empty, the gateway then rejects every later request in that session with 'content or tool_calls must be set', and the session is dead with no way back through chat. This plugin registers a single llm/stream waterfall listener and, only when the turn carried nothing visible, injects a small text block immediately before the terminal finish, so the persisted message is never empty. Ships the fixture DSH's own mock cannot express (a strictly reasoning-only SSE server, since llm-mock-server forbids an empty successText and always appends text after reasoning), plus an end-to-end reproduction that replays a real persisted session through DSH's own serializeMessages. Preventive, not a repair. Zero dependencies, one file, no process or filesystem access.

items.name: dsh-todo-continuity
items.desc: Keeps an unfinished task list visible across turns. DSH clears the todos projection at the start of every turn and expects the model to rewrite the whole list, so when a turn is interrupted the plan is durably in the session log but permanently gone from the UI — and todo_write is write-only, so neither the user nor the model can read it back. This plugin registers one ordinary session/event listener, remembers the last list per session, and when a turn/start arrives whose remembered list still has unfinished work, re-appends that list so the projection stops reporting an empty plan. No fork of tool-todo and no waterfall: a plugin cannot replace the projection (the registry throws on a stateVersion mismatch), so appending the event the fold reacts to is the reachable seam. Deliberately narrow — only unfinished lists, at most one event per turn start, fails open. Verified by a controlled A/B on real sessions: identical runs differing only in whether the plugin was installed, folded through the real projection definition. Zero dependencies.

items.desc: Inject steering or correction into a running session while the model is thinking, or cancel the current turn, from a floating browser panel.

items.name: dsh-continuechat
items.desc: Resume a conversation whose turn stopped early: /continue and an action-row button carry the interrupted reply on, covering manual stops, failed model requests, output-token cutoffs and crash recovery, and the continuation prompt is retired from the transcript once it has been answered.

items.name: dsh-auto-workspace
items.desc: Project-less chats for dsh: a session created without a workspace gets its own directory under ~/Documents/DSH/<date>/chat-NN, reused whenever the chat is reopened and left in Ungrouped rather than made a sidebar project; the new-session hero gains a hover clear badge and a "work without a project" row, and a client-only sentinel workspace keeps that hero and its composer usable.

items.name: clutch-dsh#clutch-dsh-title
items.desc: Configurable deterministic session titles for DeepSeek Harness from semantic prompt fields and templates.

items.name: bites-the-dsh
items.desc: Adds read-only, scriptable playback to native DSH conversations, with simulated user typing, forward and reverse playback, event stepping, speed control, idle-gap compression, and direct seeking by event, turn, or recorded time.

items.name: dsh-reference-anything
items.desc: Reference workspace files, DSH sessions, and historical ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok, and Kimi conversations from the unified DSH @ menu.

items.name: dsh-session-window#dsh-session-window-client
items.desc: Adds an Open in new window action to the DSH session menu when paired with the repository's native Desktop shell patch.

items.name: dsh-session-chat-share
items.desc: Share a selected chat segment as Markdown, HTML, TXT, or PNG; Session-header dialog with range or multi-select, redaction, tool calls, and subagent conversations, plus the /share command.

items.name: dsh-archive-manager
items.desc: Archived-session manager for DSH Web: workspace-grouped list, FTS5 full-text search over session content with per-session snippets, restore-and-open, and hard delete.

items.name: dsh-archive-workbench
items.desc: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session row menu that permanently removes the session log directory, projection cache and archive/pin membership and drops its row from the sidebar, plus an archived-sessions panel where archived sessions can be restored or deleted.

items.name: dsh-daily-chat
items.desc: Splits New Session in the DSH web sidebar into two modes: a 日常聊天 row opens a session on the `daily` agent preset the plugin installs into the harness home (persona, web search and fetch, ask-user and compaction — no files, shell, plan mode or subagents), inside its own daily-chat workspace whose sidebar region lists only those chats, while 开始工作 keeps the shipped coding agent; the built-in New Session button is hidden and every other New Session entry point follows the active mode, which is remembered in localStorage.

items.name: dsh-session-title-pattern
items.desc: Reformats dsh session titles as "date | type | topic" (type and topic are summarized by a model from the full conversation), and hides unused sessions from the sidebar without deleting them.

items.name: dsh-plugin-session-purge#plugin
items.desc: Permanently delete a DSH session — not just archive it — cascading over its log directory, projection cache, workspace bookkeeping and child (subagent) sessions. Adds a settings-page panel that groups sessions by workspace with size, age and live/archived/child markers, supports filtering and batch deletion, and confirms each deletion inline below the row.

items.name: dsh-session-radar
items.desc: Sidebar unread / waiting / status hub for DSH Web: a bell jumps to the next unread session, a shortcut walks sessions waiting for input, and ⌘⇧, / ⌘⇧. step back and forward through the conversations you have visited; one overlay lists unread and pending sessions side by side; a six-metric readout at the sidebar foot makes every icon a button that jumps to the next session of that kind; a host-side ledger keeps the account across restarts, so an unread session keeps its green row dot after a restart, and a startup dialog offers to re-send a continue message to sessions whose turn was cut off.

items.name: dsh-delete-turn
items.desc: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.

items.name: dsh-whale-post#bus
items.desc: File-backed post office between DeepSeek Harness sessions: every letter is sealed with an HMAC and a body digest, recipients are resolved through a roster interface, and delivery is offline-first, so an undeliverable letter waits in the mailbox instead of being lost.

items.name: dsh-plugin-session-trash
items.desc: Session trash for DSH: move sessions to a recoverable trash, restore or purge them in settings.

items.name: dsh-whats-up
items.desc: What's up - a zero-maintenance status board for your sessions. Scans every conversation on the host, extracts a goal + one-line status per session (multi-provider LLM, fingerprint-cached), surfaces half-done, unanswered and recent work in a sidebar panel, and jumps you back into any session with one click.

items.name: dsh-compact-selected-model
items.desc: /compact and auto-compaction summarize with the model selected in the session, not the model that finished the last turn.

items.name: dsh-message-forward
items.desc: Cross-session message forwarding between DSH sessions: extract one model reply, a user message, or a multi-selected batch of messages and images from one session and deliver it into another, with silent send, draft fill, or send-and-jump delivery, plus prompt templates.

items.name: dsh-rollback
items.desc: TRAE-style conversation rollback — per-turn checkpoints (10-turn sliding window) roll back touched files and truncate model context in place, keeping the same session id. Human-initiated only: a /rollback command or a per-turn Web button (works on interrupted turns too), with a preview listing each affected file and its action — restore, recover, delete, or skip.

items.name: dsh-attention-health
items.desc: Content-degradation detection (thinking loops, output repetition) for DeepSeek Harness, with a continue-vs-handoff cost verdict and zero-model handoff documents.

items.name: dsh-chatsync
items.desc: Two-way sync of DSH sessions, workspace mappings, settings and patches between machines through your own private GitHub repo (API keys stay machine-local).

items.name: dsh-context-compression-improved
items.desc: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.

items.name: dsh-date-wrapper
items.desc: Compresses DSH time-context from ~280 chars to 46 chars by injecting a compact date line into the runtime-context snapshot; zero runtime dependencies.

items.name: dsh-search-index
items.desc: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.

items.name: dsh-session-guard
items.desc: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.

items.name: dsh-session-steward
items.desc: Session Steward for DSH: browse and bulk-prune the official session archive set, and run a four-gate health checkup (log integrity, projection cache, lossless JSON, cold read) that ends in a reversible, backup-first prescription. Never rewrites session logs.

items.name: lazynoobscockloft#dsh-session-notes
items.desc: Session notes 0.3.1: multiple numbered notes per session (1 2 3… by creation order), session-level color and pin (one click in the popover title row), a copy picker (click any note to copy), per-session delete-all, compatible with DSH Desktop 0.8.2.

items.name: dsh-conversation-link
items.desc: Peer communication between conversations in one DeepSeek Harness process: list the conversations the workspace shows, link one under a nickname, message it without waiting for its turn to end, read its progress without waking it, and declare rules for your own tool calls.

items.name: dsh-session-keepwarm
items.desc: Keeps the most recently used sessions resident in the browser so switching back reuses the already loaded history instead of re-reading it; the number of resident sessions is configurable and the plugin can be switched off.

items.name: dsh-archive-manager
items.desc: Archived-conversation manager for DeepSeek Harness: view archived conversations grouped by workspace, restore them, and reveal their transcript folders.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Adds a red "Delete session" row beneath Archive in the sidebar session menu and permanently deletes that one session - its stored logs and its workspace account entry, written through the workspace registry itself. A second click confirms and the row leaves the list immediately; sessions opened this run are disposed from memory first so nothing resurrects them, and a session running work shows one extra warning whose click stops the task before deleting.

items.name: dsh-driftwatch
items.desc: Behavior-drift reports for DSH sessions: compares two session logs and reports tool-sequence alignment, tool mix, reasoning volume, timing, retries and file targets, with an optional CI threshold gate. Zero dependencies.

items.name: dsh-session-conductor
items.desc: Session management for DSH: archive/restore, batch & conditional delete, AI auto-rename, interrupted-session auto-resume, workspace grouping, undo last message, repair damaged session logs (seq-gap/EIO/dual-format), value analysis and full-text search — plus plan/closing template injection (system prompt + context).

items.name: dsh-session-migrate
items.desc: Cross-version session migration for DSH: sweeps legacy session stores (v0 plaintext, .zstd and .zip exports), re-pins the header cwd to the target workspace and drops sessions in so the persistence layer upgrades them on open; settings sidebar with env/import/list/convert tabs plus a CLI (check / fix / import).

items.name: dsh-fork-relink
items.desc: Fork companion for DSH: on any official fork, copies every direct subagent child of the source session onto the forked conversation (recursively, whole subtrees) through the official agent API, leaving each copy as a cold session the official resume path can wake — so the new conversation keeps its subagent panel and can keep messaging those children, while the originals stay with the old branch.

items.name: dsh-lorebooklike-prompt-tool
items.desc: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.

items.name: akasha-book#akasha-session
items.desc: Indexes session transcripts into the Akasha session layer as turns end, records successful compactions, and adds a per-turn rhythm line to the runtime context. Companions: Hindsight (repo memory), OpenViking (user memory), and the built-in session search (see repo README). Setup: clone the repo, copy core/ aside, then replace <AKASHA_DIR> in cordis.patch.yml with its absolute path (or set the AKASHA_DIR env var); plugins fail loudly while the placeholder remains.

items.name: dsh-agent-sync
items.desc: Mirrors other coding agents' sessions into DeepSeek Harness as continuable tasks, one workspace per application.

items.name: dsh-force-compact
items.desc: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.

items.name: dsh-pin-sessions
items.desc: Pin and unpin sessions to the top of the Web sidebar with a dedicated pinned panel, archive section, and native three-dot menu integration.

items.name: dsh-input-rewriter
items.desc: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long text untouched and keeping multi-part questions numbered.

items.name: dsh-recovery-resume
items.desc: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation that requires verifying real-world state first rather than assuming a side effect succeeded or failed. Permanent failures (AUTH, QUOTA, context overflow) are skipped, with a cross-restart budget, adaptive backoff and a minimal-context payload.

items.name: dsh-msg-rewind
items.desc: Conversation rewind for dsh web: /undo rolls back one turn, /rewind cuts to a past message, and hovering a user bubble offers a visual undo.

items.name: dsh-session-find
items.desc: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool call / tool result / system), groups results by turn, merges identical snippets, offers prose-vs-everything scope, regex / case / whole-word options, highlights all matches, and copies or exports the result set as Markdown.

items.name: dsh-client-auto-retry
items.desc: Auto-resumes interrupted DSH turns: sends a queued 「继续」 after turn/end with error, interrupted or max-tokens reasons, with a grace period, cooldown, exponential backoff, a consecutive-attempts cap, boot-time scanning, a settings card and a per-session stop/restore button in the composer toolbar; it never switches models or providers.

items.name: dsh-faster-compress
items.desc: Prepares context summaries in the background and applies them at safe step boundaries, with native compaction fallback and a per-conversation history of summaries, application status, timings, and token usage.

items.name: dsh-session-control
items.desc: Session management for the DSH sidebar: pin conversations, search their contents, read archived transcripts and hide noise.

items.name: dsh-session-insights
items.desc: See how you have been using AI: `/session-insights` reviews your DSH sessions over time, shows what worked, which problems kept coming back, and what results were actually produced, then creates a retrospective report on your machine.

items.name: dsh-session-janitor
items.desc: Lists DSH session records and archive caches on a sidebar page, moves deletions into a restorable recycle bin, and refuses sessions written within the last 10 minutes.

items.name: dsh-session-toolkit
items.desc: Consolidated toolkit for session identity, global & workspace prompts with referenced files, session auto-resume, UAC-free web restart, and peer-session messaging.

items.name: dsh-session-cleaner
items.desc: Manage conversation records from the DSH web GUI settings page: delete a whole session (archive plus physical log removal) or a single message (deleting a user message cascades to its assistant replies and tool results). Running and current sessions are protected.

items.name: dsh-sessionflow
items.desc: Continues work across coding agents inside DeepSeek Harness: six sessionflow_* tools query a local session index built by sessionFlow to find past work, show where the current project left off, and hand the goal, files and open items to the next agent. Requires the separate sessionFlow core, installed from its GitHub repo. Everything stays local — no cloud, no telemetry.

items.name: dsh-restart-autoresume
items.desc: Adds confirmed DSH restart actions and durable automatic continuation for eligible top-level sessions through an existing compatible dsh-restart Host provider.

items.name: dsh-session-resilience
items.desc: Adds DSH restart and stop controls with token-aware reconnect and policy-based recovery for interrupted web sessions.

items.name: dsh-session-shield
items.desc: Guards session logs from malformed model tool calls (empty id/name, non-string arguments) so a bad call can never make a session unloadable.

items.name: dsh-session-bridge
items.desc: Session bridge for DeepSeek Harness: drive other real DSH sessions straight from your prompt — create top-level sessions in any workspace, message or steer any session, wait for replies and stream them segment-by-segment (chain-of-thought included), resume offline sessions, find sessions across workspaces, run a background watchdog that monitors and schedules a main task (nudge when stalled, correct drift, cancel when stuck), and archive sessions with one command.

items.name: dsh-session-plugin
items.desc: Recall previously sent messages in the input box with Up/Down, and archive a workspace session from its right-click menu.

items.name: dsh-plugin-subagent-delete
items.desc: Ownership-checked tools and HTTP routes to list, release and permanently delete subagent sessions, with automatic web UI refresh after deletion.

items.name: dsh-conversation-recycle-bin
items.desc: Delete a DSH conversation from its sidebar menu or the conversation header, optionally cascading into that conversation's associated memory nodes when you tick the box (the confirmation dialog shows the hit count before you commit); deletes land in a plugin recycle bin with restore, every action is appended to an audit log, and batch deletes are rate-limited with per-conversation rollback.

items.name: dsh-session-chains
items.desc: Groups the sessions that hand off to each other into one chain in the DSH sidebar — automatic chain detection from the handoff prompt, per-chain numbering, in-place rename, search, drag and multi-select to re-chain, pinning a chain to the top, archiving chains out of the sidebar into a panel-only archive, a per-session context/steps readout, and configurable handoff thresholds that can trigger an automatic handoff (write the next prompt, open a new session, paste it, switch over).

items.name: dsh-toolong-warning
items.desc: Counts completed compactions per session in a floating window and warns only after repeated compactions plus extra token spend or high context occupancy, with all three thresholds adjustable in Settings.

items.name: dsh-md-export
items.desc: Export the current session to clean Markdown from a button in the session header, through the native save dialog, with a CLI and an HTTP route over the same renderer; reads session logs directly (formats v0, v3 and v4) and declares no @deepseek-ai peer dependencies.

items.name: dsh-concise
items.desc: One-click Concise output style for DeepSeek Harness: results first, no filler, same work depth. Every final reply opens with a plain-language digest card (select text to copy), scoped per session, working in headless/CLI too, with /concise command, style.md overrides and a local API. Links and file paths inside the digest card render as clickable chips: URLs jump, local files open with the OS default app (v0.9+). A per-step pre-generation contract reminder (v0.11.2+) measurably fixes digest misses on audit-report/table-shaped replies.

items.name: dsh-manage-sessions
items.desc: Native-feeling session manager: bulk archive/restore/hard-delete, two-stage force-stop with auto-resume, and instant copy-workspace-path.

items.name: dsh-smart-compact
items.desc: Codex-style context window auto-management for DeepSeek Harness: a lossless rollover engine with zero summarization model calls, task-oriented handoff anchors, working notes that survive compaction, verbatim recall of archived windows, and a stale-notes gate that downgrades to an explicit warning instead of vouching for outdated notes. One-click composer button plus /smart-compact command, three-band automatic rollover, mandatory anchor sanitization; works out of the box with zero configuration.

items.name: dsh-session-sweeper
items.desc: Scan, view, and safely clean local AI terminal session histories (Claude Code, Codex CLI, WorkBuddy, DSH) from a settings card — quarantine-first with SHA-256 manifests, one-click restore, audit log, and phrase-confirmed hard delete.

items.name: dsh-session-categories
items.desc: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category deletion that archives contained sessions.

items.name: dsh-session-manager
items.desc: Session manager panel under Settings → Plugins: list all sessions with title, cwd, agent preset, updated time, turns and steps, expand a row to view message history, delete non-running sessions, and export a session as JSON or Markdown via a browser Blob URL.

items.name: dsh-recent-sessions
items.desc: Lists recent sessions across every workspace in one panel, with time grouping, two sort orders, content search, reveal-in-file-manager, and local notes that offer to insert themselves into the draft.

items.name: dsh-session-rotate-on-compact
items.desc: Rotate the outbound LLM session ID after each successful DSH compaction without creating a new DSH session.

items.name: dsh-session-move
items.desc: Move a session to another folder, permanently delete it, or AI-rename it from the Web UI — by dragging a session row onto a folder title or from the session menu. Moving rewrites the session header cwd, relocates the persisted log and updates workspace accounting so history travels with it; deleting stops running agents and removes the log, projection-cache row and workspace accounting. The same three operations ship as agent tools: workbench_session_move, workbench_session_delete and workbench_session_rename_ai.

items.name: context-assembler-dsh
items.desc: Context Assembler plugin for DeepSeek Harness: topic-block context assembly, water-pressure topic splitting, tool trace/rewrite, reality recall injection and handoff planning.

items.name: dsh-context-mode
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness adapter for Context Mode: in-process ctx_* tools for sandboxed code execution and an FTS5 knowledge base, plus context-window routing guidance.

items.name: dsh-context-maid
items.desc: Context curation for DeepSeek Harness: content-aware tool-output slimming, dead-log sweep, pinned user requirements and in-flight work, archive-then-compact with an audit trail.

items.name: dsh-session-colors
items.desc: Give any Session a colour mark, shown as a chip in the sidebar and picked from the conversation header; marks are stored on the Host, so a colour chosen on one device is visible on every other one.

items.name: deepseek-harness-desktop-ultra#dsh-plugin-canvas
items.desc: Infinite canvas for sessions, with regions bound to workspaces and agent presets, pinned session cards, sticky notes and alignment guides.

items.name: dsh-takeover
items.desc: Cross-agent session relay: a compact "Relay" chip in the composer toolbar unfolds a floating workbench to browse recent sessions of eight external agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ZCode, Pi, WorkBuddy, Cursor, Grok); one click spawns a DSH session with the takeover command delivered and auto-switches to it. handoff: 1 protocol inbox cards are consume-once with a four-state evidence ledger; patches ride with cards; cross-machine relay via a synced folder. Settings keeps the command reference and reader toggles.

items.name: keep-reminder
items.desc: Injects the contents of a .keep-reminder file from the session working directory as a system-reminder, with three modes: once per session, first step of every turn, or every request.

items.name: dsh-archive
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages archived sessions and the trash from the settings panel.

items.name: dsh-recall-sessions
items.desc: A lightweight plugin that decompresses and reads past sessions, so a new session can read what an earlier conversation contained, in milliseconds per read. `/recall` lists the sessions of the current project with title, last activity, turn count and first prompt; `/recall <number>` reads back the turns of that session; `/recall all` covers every project; the model can also be asked in natural language to query with the `recall_sessions` tool.

items.name: dsh-gui-last-session
items.desc: Reopens the conversation you were last in after restarting DeepSeek Harness, by keeping a pointer file under the DSH home directory instead of patching engine files.

items.name: dsh-session-cleaner
items.desc: Adds Delete to the DSH sidebar session menu, moving the session — and its whole descendant tree when it has subagents — into a recycle bin that relocates the directory on disk (an atomic rename, never a copy), plus a sidebar bin panel with title and full-text search, workspace filter, sorting, per-session chat-log viewer, restore and permanent delete. Deleting also clears the workspace slot, the pin, the archive flag and the projection-cache row, so a restore puts the session back at its original sidebar position; permanent deletion also clears the schedules bound to it and removes the emptied project directory. Verified on DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2, with a whole-profile residue scan coming back clean.

items.name: dsh-asc
items.desc: Model-driven context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. The agent decides when and what to compress, commits durable session-log replacements, and ships reversible tool-result compression with byte-exact hash retrieval.

items.name: dsh-projectless-session
items.desc: Adds a Session without workspace entry to the DSH Workspace picker, creates isolated date-organized directories, and keeps started sessions resumable under Ungrouped.

items.name: dsh-session-fork
items.desc: Git-style conversation branching that mirrors how real programmers collaborate: a secretary root branch dispatches tasks to child branches with their own contexts, merging back only compressed summaries via squash or rebase; ships /branch commands, a branch tab, branch-to-branch messaging, and a governance baseline pairing each session branch with a git worktree.

items.name: dsh-btw-plugin
items.desc: Codex-style /btw command: answer side questions in a conversation-seeded subagent (fork provider), rendered in the UI without entering the main session history.

items.name: agent-context-editor#deepseek-harness
items.desc: Agent Context Editor is a cross-agent plugin for manually excluding, editing, and selectively compressing AI conversation context. It also supports searching, filtering, selecting, hiding, restoring, and undoing conversation changes while preserving the original Session.

items.name: dsh-plugin-btw
items.desc: Adds /btw and /side slash commands that answer ephemeral side questions in an isolated forked sub-session without polluting the main conversation context.

items.name: dsh-snapcompact
items.desc: Bitmap-frame context compression plugin for DeepSeek Harness: renders discarded conversation history into pixel-font PNG frames for vision-capable models.

items.name: dsh-time-context
items.desc: Injects the exact current local time and the timestamp, day relation and recency gap of the previous user message into every prompt, and adds a /time command that prints the injected block.

items.name: dsh-session-mindmap
items.desc: Turns a DSH session into a self-contained interactive HTML mind map of its topics, conclusions, decisions, todos and open questions, and reports what changed since the previous run.

items.name: dsh-session-cleaner-host
items.desc: Deletes a whole conversation from the sidebar session menu, and opens a right-click menu on a chat text selection with Copy, Quote (insert a Markdown quote block into the composer) and Ask: Ask sends the selection plus your question to one reused continuable subagent (label `ask`, found again through the subagent catalog after a restart) and streams the answer into the right sidebar.

items.name: smart-compaction
items.desc: Lets the model trigger compaction itself at a safe point via a compact_now tool (works mid-turn), plus a context_status tool reporting real token usage against the session's actual context window.

items.name: dsh-rewind-plugin
items.desc: Recall a message you already sent: the session log stays append-only and nothing is deleted, while the recalled turns leave the model context and the transcript, the text returns to the composer, and the files those turns changed wait in a quarantine you can review and clear from its own settings page.

items.name: dsh-archive-manager
items.desc: Two-tab archive panel (archived / active) where every row offers archive or unarchive next to permanent delete; each row shows its bound workspace folder as a clickable path, and queued archive-entry cleanup keeps a deleted session from resurfacing in the active list.

items.name: dsh-message-datetime
items.desc: One-line clock context for DeepSeek Harness: a Current time timestamp reading (weekday, date, time, UTC offset, IANA timezone) opens every conversation turn and a Turn ended reading closes it, so the model always knows the time, date and idle gap across turns without asking.

items.name: dsh-session-prefix
items.desc: Auto-classify DeepSeek Harness sessions via Jev decision models or Agent tools, displayed as title emoji prefixes (wip 🚧, blocked ⏸️, review 👀, done ✅, plan 💡, bug 🐛). Features seamless lifecycle recovery, optional Jev inference (needs a Jev API key), model tool maintenance, and a visual settings panel.

items.name: dsh-archive-purge
items.desc: Force-hides archived sessions from the DSH sidebar whatever the view filter is set to, and adds a panel that restores them or deletes them permanently - session log directory, archive and pin records, and projection cache.

items.name: dsh-chat-tree
items.desc: Draws every branch of a conversation as a clickable tree beside the chat, with favorites, custom icons and colors, branch merge and split, rewind-aware layout, and Claude Code branches that keep their memory.

items.name: dsh-archive-sessions
items.desc: Archived-session manager: an "Archived Sessions" settings page that lists archived sessions and lets you restore or permanently delete each one (two-step confirmation).

items.name: dsh-delete-session
items.desc: Adds a Delete session item to the sidebar session-row menu; the confirmation mode is configurable (click again, confirm in a dialog, or delete immediately) and a session that is running a task is refused.

items.name: dsh-air
items.desc: Web composer enhancement: recalls sent prompts across sessions with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, searches them with Ctrl+R, restores rich drafts, and opens a docked /btw or /side conversation.

items.name: dsh-assembly.resume
items.desc: Import local Codex CLI/Desktop, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Desktop conversations into DSH with project grouping, semantic history, and tool activity; bind an existing or replacement workspace and continue with the DSH Agent.

items.name: dsh-archive-viewer
items.desc: Archived-session manager for the DSH Web GUI: search titles and message content, tag/filter sessions, read logs, restore sessions, and export ZIP archives.

items.name: dhs-plugins#dsh-session-monitor
items.desc: Sidebar badge and panel that aggregate per-session pending, running, and completed states across workspaces, with one click to open a session.

items.name: dsh-session-archive
items.desc: Sidebar panel for archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness: group by workspace, search by title, preview user questions, one-click restore, or delete with confirmation.

items.name: dsh-session-nav
items.desc: Piano-key style in-conversation navigation bar: one key per user message, hover preview tooltip, click-to-jump across full history. Official dual-face dsh plugin, no dsh source changes.

items.name: dsh-reply-forge-v3
items.desc: Edits assistant replies and thinking chains in DSH sessions so the model sees the edited text, live via message projection or on disk.

items.name: dsh-butler-archive
items.desc: DSH web plugin that browses, previews, restores and deletes archived sessions that were moved out of the sessions directory.

items.name: citeciter#citeciter
items.desc: Select text in a committed DSH response to open an independent, persistent, read-only multi-turn Topic bound to source-session evidence and project files while the source Agent keeps running.

items.name: dsh-session-eval
items.desc: Retrospective agent-session evaluation: deterministic grade cards and cross-session regression diffs from persisted logs — no benchmark runs, no LLM judges.

items.name: dsh-session-export
items.desc: Session evidence reports: /transcript writes styled HTML / Markdown / JSON reports from canonical logs, /stats prints a terminal stats card, /archive writes per-session ZIPs.

items.name: dsh-session-recall
items.desc: Deterministic cross-session transcript retrieval: the `recall` tool searches past session logs with explicit scope control.

items.name: dsh-message-recall
items.desc: Adds hover Recall / Delete / Delete-onward actions to every message row: removes content from the model context and the transcript together via durable append-only tombstones, with an empty-content guard so old deletions can never break strict providers. Tested on the DSH 2.0 desktop.

items.name: dsh-session-ref
items.desc: Cross-session reference (mention) plugin — paste @[label](dsh-session:…) into any session, including one in another workspace, and the host injects the referenced session snapshot for the model to read; includes a one-click copy-reference button.

items.name: dsh-maze
items.desc: Execution maze for DSH sessions: the agent's real path — main advance, failed or dead-end detours, backtracks, request retries and subagent branches — drawn on one wall-clock timeline, with three tracks under each lane sharing that axis (tool-call density, token pulse, context pressure) and a deterministic analysis panel below it (tool result matrix, failure-recovery chains, duration distribution); watch it grow live in a session tab, or upload up to 5 session logs for a same-axis compare.

items.name: dsh-workspace-drag
items.desc: Drag a conversation onto any workspace group in the sidebar to relocate it between DSH workspaces, updating its cwd, disk location and registry ownership.

items.name: dsh-plugin-archived-conversations
items.desc: Manage archived conversations in the Settings UI: unarchive them back to the sidebar, or permanently delete them with confirmation.

items.name: wechat-agent-router
items.desc: Route each WeChat group session to a different Agent preset by group name, reusing dsh-wechat-assistant without changing its code.

items.name: dsh-synapse
items.desc: Visual, non-linear conversation workspace for DeepSeek Harness — sessions, follow-ups and branches become a browsable conversation map.

items.name: dsh-lark-session-monitor-plugin
items.desc: Watches Feishu (Lark) conversations with your own user identity and forwards new messages as prompts into a chosen DeepSeek Harness session: per-monitor sender filters, @bot-mention bypass and keyword allow/block lists, auto-created pinned target sessions, and cursor-based polling that re-reads messages after a failed delivery.

items.name: dsh-plugin-session-cascade-delete
items.desc: Delete a session from the UI (session-header button or sidebar row menu) or with the session_delete tool: stops and releases a running agent and its live session first, then removes the log directory, projection cache and workspace accounting, and cascades into the subagent sessions it owns while leaving forked branches untouched.

items.name: dsh-session-delete-next
items.desc: Adds a Delete session action to the sidebar session menu that permanently deletes the local records of that session, while refusing sessions that are running.

items.name: dsh-recap
items.desc: Summarizes the current DeepSeek Harness session with /recap or after inactivity, with configurable models, Chinese and English output, and expandable summaries in the conversation.

items.name: dsh-loulan-rules
items.desc: Injects the rule files under $DSH_HOME/rules and <cwd>/.dsh/rules into the conversation at the first agent pre-step, re-injecting them after compaction.

items.name: dsh-archive-favorites-forge
items.desc: Favourite any conversation from the sidebar row menu or an inline star, copy its id plus the transcript absolute path in one click, and permanently delete a single conversation behind a confirm — the sidebar row drops at once. A settings card batch-archives sessions idle past a configurable hour threshold with one-click undo, exports the candidates as a tab-separated txt carrying name, id, workspace, idle time and last activity, and batch-deletes archived conversations that are not favourites. Two view-options rows narrow the sidebar to favourites that are archived and to those that are not. Every addition is additive — three official slots plus one cloned filter row, editing no official file.

items.name: dsh-session-telecom
items.desc: Copy session IDs, send messages to live or saved sessions, and view session token usage.

items.name: dsh-session-status
items.desc: Per-session status labels (built-in active/done/paused plus custom) shown in the sidebar, conversation header, and hover card, with editable colors.

items.name: dsh-btw
items.desc: Side-ask drawer opened from a completed answer's action row: follow-up questions run in an independent, auto-archived session seeded with the prior conversation text (read-only, capped at 48,000 characters), leaving the main session untouched. The side session inherits the main session's model, switchable inside the drawer, with a context-usage ring.

items.name: dsh-sqy-rewind
items.desc: Rewinds a session to before a chosen user turn, from a button beside Copy under your own message — the model-visible surface is replaced in place and the interface hides the rewound turns, without patching DSH source or deleting the original session log.

items.name: context-guardian
items.desc: Compaction fallback for compaction-basic: when its LLM summary throws, comes back empty or cannot fit the window, the span is compiled deterministically with a seq pointer on every line (vendored dsh-compaction-instant compiler). Adds recall and search tools, /recall and /context commands, an idle trigger at 45% of the window and an on-disk span archive. The engine mounts as one row in the agent preset (docs/dsh-integration.md).

items.name: automatic-session-renaming-for-dsh
items.desc: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with configurable title language and max title bytes.

items.name: better-dsh-session-deletetool
items.desc: Permanently delete DSH conversations with optional recursive deletion of forked and subagent sessions.

items.name: dsh-session-inherit
items.desc: Adds an Inherit row to the session menu: mechanically extracts concrete anchors (task, recent instructions, files edited, recent failures, commands, todos) from a long session into a handoff and continues in a clean session, with the same preset, no history copied and no model call.

items.name: dsh-graft
items.desc: Graft, forward and fork DSH sessions: read a slice of one session log, export it, fork at a turn boundary, or forward a selection into another session as a self-contained graft message.

items.name: dsh-ma-plugins#dsh-handoff
items.desc: Secret-redacted session handoff with review, auto-start, and brief-only modes.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Permanently delete a session from the session row menu — archives the id, removes the log directory and drops the row at once, with a Delete shortcut; built only on shipped extension points, and a session that was merely opened stays deletable.

items.name: dsh-block-ptc
items.desc: Model-directed context compaction for PTC mode, grouping program runs into blocks and replacing completed block messages with model-written summaries.

items.name: dsh-btw
items.desc: Adds /btw for one-off, context-aware side questions without tool execution, with independent answer bubbles that can be copied, collapsed, or closed without adding answers to the main conversation.

items.name: dsh-session-mgr
items.desc: Move, archive, restore, portable backup/export and import sessions across workspaces in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

items.name: dsh-session-eater
items.desc: Session cleanup for the DSH sidebar: drag a conversation row onto the balance widget's whale and it eats the row — the session directory goes to a recycle bin, not to rm. Deletion asks one short question first (how many tokens it burned, and that prompt can be turned off in Settings). Undo from the persistent toast or the 12-entry log in Settings. Clicking the whale jumps straight to the plugin's Settings, where you can swap the avatar, drag the mouth into place and rewrite all 17 UI strings; blank, currently-open and running sessions are refused in place with a reason.

items.name: dsh-infinite-gen-4
items.desc: System-prompt armor plugin for DeepSeek models: appends an unconditional-compliance prompt section at order 100, exposes a profile tool with calibration metadata, and shows a realtime armor-status badge driven by a session projection.

items.name: missher-dsh-context-manager
items.desc: Inspect conversation context and apply configurable compaction with usage history.

items.name: missher-dsh-session-bridge
items.desc: Displays and copies full session IDs, provides cross-session listing, reading and messaging, and creates scratch workspaces.

items.name: dsh-archive-manager
items.desc: Archived-session manager for DeepSeek Harness: grouped archive panel with restore and delete.

items.name: dsh-revert
items.desc: A production-ready UI Rewind/Revert plugin for DSH. Features inline prompt editing and a flawless dual-engine state recovery system (Workspace ShadowGit + External Tracker) with full support for forked sessions.

items.name: dsh-session-pruner
items.desc: Full-type session lifecycle management: one-shot subagents archived on completion, idle continuable subagents / main sessions archived (recoverable), a capacity cap, projection-cache cleanup, and a hot-reload settings panel.

items.name: dsh-plugin#dsh-session-manager
items.desc: Session management: auto-archives stale sessions on a configurable threshold, with an archive panel, unarchive, and recycle-bin deletion with restore.

items.name: dsh-session-drafts
items.desc: Cursor-style New Session: every click creates a fresh blank draft session (persisted before the first message) instead of reusing the workspace's single one, plus a sidebar Drafts switcher to keep several empty chats open at once.

items.name: dsh-healthcheck
items.desc: Session health check for DSH, read-only: scans the whole session library (totals, largest sessions, warnings for oversized sessions and event-count blowups) and deep-inspects a single session log (tail-balance / crash-tail check, tool-call/result pairing, event-type distribution).

items.name: dsh-preset-switcher-fork
items.desc: Switch the current session's agent preset (mode) at any time, including after the conversation has already started, from a session-header dropdown backed by a fenced POST /preset-switch/api route. The route also repairs sessions whose recorded preset was deleted. Fork of jeffcwj/dsh-preset-switcher updated for DSH 0.2.1.

items.name: dsh-session-progress
items.desc: Session progress tracking for DeepSeek Harness, without digging through the logs: the agent keeps a live nested checklist of the work — from a whole phase down to a single step — and every item carries a weight, so the ring and the % pill in the composer dock row always match reality. Hover it for the current activity, or open the Session Progress tab in the native right sidebar for the goal, the weighted checklist with per-item shares, the next steps and the working notes; when the session ends, the same checklist stands as a clean record of what got done.

items.name: dsh-resume-on-restart
items.desc: Auto-wakes the main agent after a DSH service restart: compares last-run timestamps, posts a recovery notice with humanized downtime, and delivers it so interrupted work picks itself back up. Runs on plain cordis ctx, packaged-DSH-Desktop ready.

items.name: dsh-task-control
items.desc: Task control for DeepSeek Harness: one-click emergency stop and force-termination of stuck downloads and tool calls, download progress, stuck detection, pwsh activity monitoring, and append-condition / pause / resume with invisible recovery.

items.name: dsh-win-minimal
items.desc: Windows minimal agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: fixed one-line persona, three tools, no runtime context.

items.name: dsh-compact-suite
items.desc: Takes over the compaction threshold on every mounted engine: forces headroomTokens to -1e6 so the ratio is the only term in the trigger, keeps retention below it on every write path, reroutes the compaction call to a chosen model, and adds a panel with a one-click compaction button and a per-session compaction log.

items.name: dsh-connection-card-host
items.desc: Makes a connection between two DSH sessions a first-class object: drag from the composer anchor or a session row to open one, set a permission in each direction, and mount cards on it. Each end gets five host tools for messaging at a chosen urgency, reading the peer work state, and sharing a convention box; awareness is pull-based, so an idle connection costs no context.

items.name: dsh-codexlike-projectless
items.desc: Adds Codex-like projectless drafts with per-project draft switching and date-and-topic directories created on first send; supports Windows DSH Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2 without an archive patch or external installer.

items.name: dsh-plugin-session-purge
items.desc: Two-step session deletion: the session menu moves a chat into a recycle bin without deleting anything, the bin panel restores an entry, deletes one for good right away, or empties the whole bin, and the next start wipes its log, projection cache, spill files and workspace membership.

items.name: dsh-welcome-back
items.desc: Welcome-back card in the conversation you return to after an idle period, using only that conversation's last message.

items.name: dsh-session-sync
items.desc: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.

items.name: dsh-workspace-mover
items.desc: Move sessions across workspaces by drag-and-drop with true in-place migration; recover orphaned or unregistered sessions; re-point stale workspaces after folder renames. IDs and history stay intact, with per-step backup and rollback.

items.name: dsh-workspace-tree
items.desc: Virtual session folders, click-to-move menu, and active task banner for DSH sidebar.

items.name: dsh-session-guard
items.desc: Prevents concurrent-write session corruption: takes a per-session advisory lock on session start and every step, so a second dsh process fails loudly instead of writing a duplicate-seq gap; dead owners are taken over automatically.

items.name: dsh-session-snapshot
items.desc: Rolling, integrity-verified backups of each session at turn boundaries: verifies the log still loads before promoting a snapshot, never overwrites the last good one when a turn ends corrupt, and restores in one command even when dsh will not boot.

items.name: dsh-session-workbench
items.desc: Session Workbench: full-text search past sessions, recall up to 3 as @references, and manage conversation-view tabs (show/hide + drag reorder).

items.name: dsh-agent-clean
items.desc: Removes subagent entries and orphaned projection caches from DeepSeek Harness session logs after the app quits, always dry-run first and with a full backup.

items.name: dsh-call-session
items.desc: Run several DeepSeek Harness sessions side by side, hand work from one to another, and watch the whole collaboration on one read-only canvas.

items.name: dsh-send-debounce
items.desc: Buffers consecutive short messages from the composer and merges them into one turn: no model wake-up until the user stops for a configurable silence window; long messages and attachments bypass the buffer.

items.name: dsh-context#ctx-mon-and-con
items.desc: Package: `ctx-mon-and-con`. Context monitoring, compaction, and prompt/tool control for DeepSeek Harness: token breakdowns, trend/event views, budget-based auto-compaction, /ctx controls, and session/global toggles. Read-only monitoring; only the official seam rewrites history.

items.name: dsh-thinking-language
items.desc: Switch the language of the agent's thinking/reasoning process (chain-of-thought): 简体中文, English, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, 日本語, 한국어 and more, or auto-follow the system locale. Adds a Settings → General row, a system-prompt instruction (per-prompt assembly, applies to new sessions), and the /thinking-language command.

items.name: dsh-auto-handoff
items.desc: DSH plugin: hands a long session over to a fresh session in the same workspace on /handoff or at a token threshold, carrying the preset, model, permissions and plan mode across; the brief is written by the session's own model and the switch waits for a step boundary instead of interrupting running work.

items.name: dsh-plugin-archive-manager
items.desc: Settings section for archived sessions: browse by workspace, search, batch unarchive with the sidebar updating live, and optional auto-archive rules (idle days, keep-last-N per workspace) with a dry-run preview — plus a left-edge turn rail for jumping between turns of long conversations and ↑/↓ input history in the composer.

items.name: dsh-client-ui-session-mention
items.desc: Type @ in the composer to reference another conversation: pick a historical session and inject its compacted context into the current prompt.

items.name: dsh-darwin#sentinel
items.desc: Session health-check: mechanically mines session logs into structured problem tickets (retry loops, tool-error clusters, interrupted turns, token waste) over the official session-query seam; works standalone.

items.name: dsh-antigravity-bridge
items.desc: Read Google Antigravity SQLite conversations in DeepSeek Harness and import them as native sidebar sessions with list, read and import tools plus slash commands.

items.name: dsh-context-compressor
items.desc: One-click context compression for the dsh web GUI: a 压缩 button on the session title bar summarizes the whole conversation into a few lines, opens a new session in the same workspace seeded with the summary, and switches to it — the original session stays untouched.

items.name: dsh-continue-on-limit
items.desc: Auto-continue for the dsh web GUI: when a local model hits its output-token cap and the max-tokens notice appears, the plugin automatically queues a short continue message so the reply keeps flowing — dual-source truncation detection, loop protection, and no UI.

items.name: billion-context
items.desc: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).

items.name: dsh-brief-session-title
items.desc: Condenses DSH session titles from a full sentence into a short verb-free phrase, aiming for under five words.

items.name: dsh-easyrewrite
items.desc: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.

items.name: dsh-minimal-session-delete
items.desc: Permanently deletes a session from the sidebar, waiting for a running turn to stop and cascading to its subagent sessions.

items.name: dsh-channel-view
items.desc: Channel-grouped session view injected into the sidebar — Workspace/Channels tabs with live-running dots, archived grouping, orphan tagging, built purely on official extension surfaces and serving as the RFC-0001 reference implementation.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Deletes a session from the sidebar session menu after a confirmation dialog, removing its log directory, projection-cache record and workspace/pin/archive accounting; registry calls are timeout-guarded so a stuck workspace registry cannot block the removal.

items.name: dsh-tree-view
items.desc: Tree view of a DSH conversation: editing an old message forks the thread, every version lives in one tree while the sidebar keeps a single entry, branches can be renamed, and a branch can be promoted to a session of its own.

items.name: dsh-off-peak-message#dsh-offpeak-send
items.desc: Off-peak message scheduler: turn on valley mode and the composer queues your messages until DeepSeek off-peak hours (half price), then auto-injects them into the session and gets replies. Native-look composer, hotkeys (Enter queue / ⌘+Enter send now / Esc exit), per-session toggle persisted across restarts.

items.name: dsh-codex-pins
items.desc: Splits the DeepSeek Harness sidebar into independently scrollable Pinned and Recents panes, and hides pinned sessions from Recents.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
items.desc: One-click prompt enhancement in the composer — rewrites the draft into a structured prompt (role and goal, executable steps, output format, acceptance criteria, edge cases) with before/after preview, fill-back, and undo. Never changes intent, never fabricates requirements.

items.name: dsh-annotation
items.desc: Annotate text in replies, diffs, or files and send notes with a message for ordered replies and source navigation; follows Host styling and automatically adapts to dsh-codex-ui.

items.name: dsh-chattree
items.desc: Shows a DSH session as a conversation canvas — every turn is a node, any turn forks a real child session, and a compacted context folds into one green node you can keep talking from; the left rail groups canvases by DSH workspace and renames them in step with the session titles.

items.name: dsh-message-fold
items.desc: Provides Codex-style session message folding for DeepSeek Harness.

items.name: dsh-session-tools
items.desc: Gives the agent four session tools: start a new session, send a message into another one, list sessions with their state, and wait for another session's turn to finish so its answer can be read back.

items.name: dsh-session-remover
items.desc: Adds Delete conversation and Batch delete to the sidebar session menu; a deleted conversation and its subagent sessions are moved to the Windows recycle bin, from where they can be restored.

items.name: dsh-highlightpin
items.desc: Pins a selected passage of a finished user or assistant message as source text and keeps it in the model input across context compaction: each pin is recall-on-demand by default, or can be moved to a neutral resident system-prompt section or an emphasised highlighted one. Selections are aligned back to the source text with source-exact, source-normalized or rendered fidelity, and each of the three levels has its own character budget.

items.name: session-reader
items.desc: Search and read local Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and DSH sessions from the 1session CLI or DSH Web history browser.

items.name: dsh-session-todos
items.desc: Floating todo panel for DSH sessions with server-side cross-device persistence and pending-task badges in the session list.

items.name: harness-session-delete
items.desc: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.

items.name: dsh-image-once
items.desc: Inlines an image block as base64 only in the one request where it first appears, and marks that same block offloaded on every later request so DSH's own image-offload projection renders it as the placeholder text carrying the read-only local path. An occurrence is keyed by session id, message id, content-tree path and attachment id, and a request is only counted after it produces its first chunk, so retries do not count as sent. Requests carrying a purpose are neither rewritten nor counted, a later read_image of the same file is a new occurrence and inlines once more, and only that request's copy is rewritten, so nothing is written back to the session.

items.name: sieve#dsh-sieve
items.desc: Filters tool outputs, prunes stale context and discloses skills on demand for DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1.

items.name: dsh-plugin-message-edit
items.desc: Message and attachment editing with save-only updates, forked regeneration, and a version timeline for DSH desktop.

items.name: agentsidecar#plugin
items.desc: Cross-agent monitoring board for local AI agent sessions (cursor-ide, claude, codex, copilot, kimi and dsh itself) with session timelines, and message injection behind a default-off two-phase confirmation gate.

items.name: dsh-team-link
items.desc: Session deep links, full session export (markdown/JSON), approved cross-session messaging with pairing, and team roster, rotation and recovery tools for multi-session work.

items.name: dsh-turn-hard-delete
items.desc: Delete a complete closed turn (question + answer + tool calls) from a DeepSeek Harness session, without deleting the session.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Permanently deletes one session from the sidebar session menu, or several at once from the "..." menu beside the sidebar section title: tick sessions in the list (running ones are refused), then confirm in a dialog — log directory, workspace membership, live Host instances and the client list row are all cleaned. The same "..." menu also collects the session search and view options. It also sweeps rows whose log is already gone, and retries a user message or an assistant reply from the button right of Copy.

items.name: obsidian-dsh-acp
items.desc: ACP adapter that drives DeepSeek Harness from Obsidian Agent Client (and other ACP clients): list, resume, fork and delete sessions, switch the model per session, preview a one-line summary, import external ACP sessions, and pull Obsidian Agent Client conversations into dsh native session storage. Requires DSH >= 0.1.5-rc.3.

items.name: dsh-context-manager
items.desc: Preview conversation context and selectively keep, summarize, or omit exchange groups before applying persistent compaction through Harness session services.

items.name: dsh-chat-keeper
items.desc: Manage DSH conversations: one cross-workspace table with batch archiving, body search over message text, and recycle-bin deletion you can undo.

items.name: dsh-task-notice-board
items.desc: Task-scoped Workspace to Task to Session control center for DSH Web, with Session boards, archived conversation viewing, and bounded long-term memory shared across linked Sessions.

items.name: dsh-nested-followups
items.desc: Keep branching from any completed answer at any depth while the main session stays untouched.

items.name: dsh-session-handoff
items.desc: Session handoff & context management: structured handoff documents (export/resume/status) so a fresh session can continue seamlessly, plus active context pruning (acp_* tools via the official compaction API with model-authored summaries).

items.name: dsh-session-task-tags
items.desc: Tag each session as a long-term or short-term task, record the agent mode it was created with, and auto-archive it once the archive window you set elapses.

items.name: dsh-bulletin#dsh-bulletin-dispatch
items.desc: Desk-to-desk tickets between sessions on one machine. A session says which desk it belongs to by putting a number prefix in its title; a ticket names one desk and is taken by the first session of that desk to start working, so the desk is the address and a ticket is not delivered to a session that is just passing by.

items.name: dsh-plugin-message-edit
items.desc: Edit a sent message to rewind and branch the conversation from that turn, switch versions with a counter under the bubble, and browse every branch in a turn-level version tree.

items.name: dsh-plugin-no-workspace
items.desc: Start and detach standalone chats without a mandatory workspace, keeping DSH's native workspace UI intact.

items.name: dsh-prompt-lib
items.desc: Prompt library stored in the plugin config, with a Settings page and a composer picker: the ticked prompts are injected into every model step of that session, and a subagent inherits the selection of its nearest ancestor session.

items.name: dsh-session-manager
items.desc: Settings-page manager for archived DeepSeek Harness sessions: restore an archived session to its previous workspace position or permanently delete it (direct physical deletion, no backup layer). Adds a red permanently-delete item to the session context menu and three agent tools. Deleting an open session works immediately; the leftover in-memory copy is hidden behind an archive tombstone until the next restart.

items.name: shl-session-history
items.desc: Conversation history rail on the left edge of the chat: each tick is one real user request, hover to preview its text, click to jump to that turn.

items.name: dsh-rich-indexing
items.desc: Tiered compaction hub: replaces the single 80% compaction cliff with a configurable ladder (default 30/50/70/90) whose tiers escalate from gentle to maximum consolidation laws, folds a deterministic keyword index into every checkpoint so facts accumulate across cycles, and summarizes through a model chain — primary plus up to 3 fallbacks, each with its own reasoning effort. Adds a Compaction module sub-tab and a Settings card; toggling off always restores stock compaction.

items.name: dsh-session-plus
items.desc: Sidebar archive directory for DSH Web: restore a session to its original workspace slot, delete the session log, or edit-and-branch a user message into a new conversation.

items.name: dsh-session-bin
items.desc: Manage native archives by workspace, with search, unarchive, and permanent deletion of individual sessions or fixed batches.

items.name: dsh-hold
items.desc: Holds a drafted message until the main agent is idle, no subagent is running and no background job is live, then sends it. Each hold takes an optional send time and a choice to queue, wait or steer, and lives on the host with its attachments so a restart does not lose it.

items.name: dsh-plugins#dsh-storage
items.desc: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.

items.name: dsh-auto-rename
items.desc: Names a session from its first prompt, and streams AI title suggestions into the rename dialog.

items.name: dsh-pinned-sessions
items.desc: Keeps running, finished-but-unopened and currently open sessions pinned above the workspace groups in the DSH Web sidebar, and lets any session or workspace be pinned there from its own "..." menu.

items.name: dsh-turn-delete
items.desc: Delete one finished turn from a DSH conversation without deleting the session — the trash button next to the last assistant reply removes the question, that reply and the tool records of the turn from the conversation surface and from the model context, while the session id, title, later turns and the append-only log stay; the removal is written as a persistent tombstone, so it survives a reload.

items.name: dsh-auto-goal-resume
items.desc: Automatically resumes active goal sessions after DSH restart; long-running tasks continue without a manual nudge.

items.name: dsh-checkpoint-diff
items.desc: Browses checkpoints produced by dsh-checkpoint-rewind as a timeline of time nodes and shows per-file line diffs between any two of them, with trace replay from session logs (no snapshot producer needed) and preview-first workspace rollback with single-shot undo, via /diff and /rollback commands, a JSON HTTP API, and a GUI panel.

items.name: dsh-sessions-manager
items.desc: Archive, restore, permanently delete, and move DeepSeek Harness sessions across workspaces from one unified settings panel.

items.name: dsh-plugin-bridge
items.desc: Moves an existing DSH session to another agent preset through a previewable five-section handoff, preserving the source session and either pausing the target for confirmation or continuing immediately.

items.name: dsh-set-workspace
items.desc: Adds a Windows Explorer right-click action to open a folder as a DSH workspace, launching DSH if needed.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Adds a "Delete" item to the sidebar session menu with a confirmation dialog, then hard-deletes the session.

items.name: dsh-unarchive
items.desc: Lists archived sessions, previews their content, restores them to the original workspace, and adds an optional archive confirmation.

items.name: dsh-conversation-find
items.desc: In-conversation keyword search for the current session: pages the history back to its first window before matching, then highlights every hit and scrolls to the one you pick.

items.name: dsh-toolkit#dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Adds a delete-session action that permanently removes session logs, workspace entries and archives.

items.name: dsh-archive-delete
items.desc: Archived-session management with single and batch deletion, native workspace registry cleanup, and deferred file cleanup while the host holds session resources.

items.name: dsh-deephub-share#dsh-deephub-share
items.desc: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.

items.name: dsh-continue
items.desc: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.

items.name: dsh-favorites
items.desc: Session favorites: bookmark any conversation into a browser-style favorites panel — one-click star from session rows, folders for organization, notes, custom display names, resume session, fork into a new session, basic session stats, plus a fork-relationship graph showing how conversations derive from one another.

items.name: dsh-smart-title
items.desc: Smart session titles for DSH: after each conversation turn an independent auxiliary LLM call summarizes the full user+assistant transcript into a title that follows the session's real topic instead of echoing the first message; the first message is titled instantly, failed built-in titles auto-retry on later turns, manual renames are never overwritten, and subagent/fork sessions are skipped.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Session management for DSH: archive or delete one session, archive/delete all sessions in a workspace, and restore archived sessions from the settings page — archiving backs up workspace metadata and restoring recreates deleted workspace registrations automatically.

items.name: dsh-handoff-button
items.desc: Adds a handoff button to every assistant message that writes an LLM-summarized handoff document of the current conversation into the workspace handoff/ directory.

items.name: dsh-session-clean-delete
items.desc: Adds a permanent Delete session action to the sidebar session menu, behind a confirmation dialog that reports the log size, running turns, subagents, background jobs and reminders bound to the session; the id is then released from the live, archive and workspace registries, so the row stays gone on refresh instead of folding back in.

items.name: dsh-plugin-workspace-archive
items.desc: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns: unarchives only the sessions it archived itself, re-attaches every member its ledger recorded (including sessions you archived manually, whose archived state is left unchanged), and adopts ungrouped sessions whose working directory is that workspace path.

items.name: dsh-inline-media-viewer-plugin
items.desc: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.

items.name: dsh-session-intent-title
items.desc: Zero-UI-overhead DeepSeek Harness plugin that automatically classifies conversation intents and names sessions with clean emoji prefixes (optimize, fix, feature, explore, etc.).

items.name: dsh-temp-workspace
items.desc: Temporary workspace for DSH web — one click creates a throwaway workspace whose conversations are deleted at the next restart (immediately or after a delay, optionally behind a confirm dialog). Pin a temp workspace to keep it: its files move into the folder you pick, its title becomes that folder's name, its conversations migrate, and a real host-level restart re-indexes them.

items.name: dsh-space-optimizer
items.desc: Per-task disk-space ledger in the sidebar with opt-in reclamation of unowned junk; session logs are never trimmed.

items.name: dsh-chat-manager
items.desc: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Adds delete and batch delete to the session list menu; sessions go to the Windows Recycle Bin instead of being erased, and the files a session produced are listed first so you decide whether to remove them together.

items.name: dsh-auto-sync
items.desc: Automatic, versioned backup of your DeepSeek Harness home — sessions, memories, settings and the profile plugin tree — to a private git remote you own, with commits and pushes on a schedule and every failure surfaced in the DSH log.

items.name: dsh-session-purge
items.desc: Adds a permanent-delete row to the sidebar menu of archived sessions, removing the session log, its projection cache and its workspace registration.

items.name: dsh-composer-enter
items.desc: Makes Enter insert a newline in the DSH 0.1.5 Web composer while Cmd/Ctrl+Enter keeps submitting messages.

items.name: dsh-auto-archive
items.desc: Auto-archives sessions idle beyond a configurable threshold, with safety guards (never touches live or running sessions), plus a full archived-session management UI: list, unarchive, safe delete and content preview.

items.name: dsh-session-xc
items.desc: Session management enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness - workspace session count display, archived sessions panel with restore/delete, drag-and-drop session move across workspaces.

items.name: dsh-prompt-easymanager
items.desc: Applies personal prompts and system-prompt edits at the global level or on a single session, so each session can work with its own prompt setup without touching the others.

items.name: dsh-context-reclaim
items.desc: Context governance for DSH: folds oversized tool results, collapses the tool surface and keeps the prompt cache warm, so long sessions stop getting more expensive.

items.name: dsh-cross-session-agent-pre
items.desc: Cross-workspace DSH messaging and sender navigation, with bounded same-workspace context and opt-in local Claude Code messaging.

items.name: dsh-session-surgeon
items.desc: Repair DeepSeek Harness sessions that refuse to load, with a sidebar Session surgeon overlay and dry-run repair.

items.name: dsh-session-map
items.desc: Session map: a fork-tree canvas over DSH sessions — a node is a session and the beads under it are that session's user inputs — opened as a conversation tab, a session-header toggle and two right-side tabs. It starts on the current session's own tree, growing downward, with wheel pan and Ctrl/⌘-wheel zoom, a global user-input toggle, a subagent-session filter, and a per-session overview of turns, steps, model time, tool time, output tokens and running state.

items.name: dsh-branch-inbox-guard
items.desc: Removes the queued prompts a DSH fork child inherits from its parent, so the first turn in a new branch runs the prompt typed there instead of the parent's next one.

items.name: dsh-vision-hub#bridge-preview
items.desc: Inline preview for \[图片: path] image bridge markers: after the marker renders, the image shows in chat automatically, keeping long instructions out of the conversation.

items.name: dsh-session-multiselect
items.desc: A searchable, workspace-grouped multi-select panel over DSH conversations for batch delete, archive and pin, with Shift-range and Ctrl-add selection.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Real session deletion with trash and restore, archived cleanup, and batch delete from settings.

items.name: dsh-sidebar-delete
items.desc: Delete sessions for real from the dsh sidebar (local logs and projection cache included, subagent and fork children cascade) and manage workspaces and ungrouped sessions, with an optional daily cleanup of ungrouped sessions.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Adds a trash for DSH sessions.

items.name: dsh-xwide-handoff
items.desc: Generates a structured handoff card so a near-full conversation continues in a fresh zero-context session: /handoff writes the card with self-incrementing titles, pins it to the top of the sidebar and prepares the new session once the context nears its threshold.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Fork of harness-session-delete that adds Delete to the native session action menu and a recycle-bin page with search, sort, workspace grouping, message preview, batch restore, and per-workspace permanent purge; active sessions are protected.

items.name: dsh-save-chat
items.desc: Save whole turns — the question plus the full answer — as plain Markdown inside the session workspace, promote the good ones into a cross-project personal knowledge base, and let the model search it on demand. No database and no runtime dependencies.

items.name: smart-session-title
items.desc: Replacement session-title provider that compresses oversized or code-heavy first prompts before calling the model (in the tested DSH version the built-in provider rejects inputs above 4096 bytes without a model call) and waits for a real task instead of titling a greeting. Titles use the session’s own provider and model by default and manual titles are protected; title rules cover a character cap, an optional date affix, style, language and exclusion words, plus a per-session lock. Also re-titles stored sessions in bulk, with a progress overlay that keeps running after Settings is closed.

items.name: dsh-retrace
items.desc: Recall, edit-and-resend and regenerate, plus in-conversation versioning: a timeline of every rewind, artifact rollback (git-first, snapshot fallback), a fork map of explored paths, session lineage, and a real-time watchdog that snapshots the log at the first sign of concurrent writes. Edits auto-stop the running agent (official cancel/whenIdle) so rewinds never corrupt the durable log or break /compact.

items.name: dsh-nutstore-backup
items.desc: Backs up DeepSeek Harness sessions, plugin config and workspace memory to Nutstore (Jianguoyun) over WebDAV, with incremental upload, connection test and one-click restore on a new machine.

items.name: dsh-knj-session-management
items.desc: Session management for DSH: archive, restore and delete persisted sessions, cap how many sessions each workspace keeps, and review disk usage in a size governance panel.

items.name: dsh-session-handoff
items.desc: Session handoff for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu creates a successor session that rebuilds the old session's memory, tasks and rules through an eight-section takeover packet, with light context via on-demand transcript readback.

items.name: dsh-unread-mark
items.desc: Session-row unread mark for DeepSeek Harness: the session menu gains Mark unread and Unmark, pinning a red dot before the session title that survives reload and opening until cleared, both entries disabled while the built-in green finished-unopened dot is present.

items.name: dsh-lang-zh
items.desc: Injects a fixed system-prompt section so the agent always replies in Simplified Chinese — including the short narration between tool calls — unless you explicitly ask for another language. Applies to every session and preset without overriding the persona.

items.name: dsh-web-search-session
items.desc: Routes DSH web search through the current session's model and a self-hosted retrieval backend.

items.name: dsh-anchor
items.desc: Session instruction anchor for DeepSeek Harness: the first step of a new session injects a freely composed instruction block as a plugin-sourced message, and it is re-anchored after a summarizing compaction, every N turns, or when metered context pressure crosses a threshold.
