An /anchor command re-anchors on demand without a model call; a settings page manages the paged preset library, injection order, re-anchor source and character limits.

items.name: dsh-big-compact
items.desc: Chunked compaction for oversized sessions: takes over only when the live context exceeds 85% of the model window (or the request exceeds 4 MB), summarizes the history in 1.5 MB chunks and merges them; smaller sessions keep the built-in compaction.

items.name: dsh-share-room
items.desc: Invites people into one conversation through single-use links with no account: up to 20 guests discuss together and ask the AI, the shared fork runs read-only, and the owner can remove guests or end the share at any time.

items.name: taskfold
items.desc: Wraps work in named tasks and, once a task closes, folds its whole span of messages into one summary at the next step boundary; the original content can be restored on demand.

items.name: dsh-zh-thinking
items.desc: Injects one system-prompt section so the agent's chain-of-thought, planning and tool-invocation reasoning stay in Simplified Chinese. Zero external dependencies - clone and link-install from any local directory, no npm build or publish required.

items.name: dsh-session-continuity
items.desc: Injects a small continuity pointer at the start of a new session, naming the previous session and any handoff file, and reuses DSH's own compaction summary when there is no handoff file.

items.name: dsh-delete-chat
items.desc: Archive, unarchive, and delete sessions from a settings page.

items.name: dsh-theone
items.desc: Talk about everything in one chat (the main chat): each message is routed automatically to the topic it belongs to, each topic runs in its own background session with its own context, and existing DSH chat history is organized into topics.

items.name: dsh-conversation-archive
items.desc: Manage archived DSH sessions on Windows with search, batch restore and deletion, AI-assisted file retention, and verified local or network-directory backups.

items.name: dsh-branchmark#dsh-branchmark
items.desc: While vibe coding, save an answer you may need later, use Side Chat for a question that suddenly comes up, or open a related conversation for deeper work without losing focus on the current task.

items.name: dsh-prompt-setting#dsh-prompt-setting
items.desc: DeepSeek Harness Default System Prompt Management Plugin: Browse, search, and override the final system prompt assembled into each session round within the Web GUI "Settings".

items.name: dsh-restart-task
items.desc: Recovers broken DSH turns: widens the product's own retry budget and renders the wait as a live countdown inside the same step, keeps a truncated output alive inside the same turn, and can open an opt-in continuation round when a turn has already ended; while the composer is empty it hands the send button to that continuation.

items.name: dsh-session-delete
items.desc: Adds a one-click delete-session row to the DSH sidebar session menu: moves the session log and its per-conversation .dsh-sessions artifact directory to the Windows Recycle Bin, with no confirmation dialog.

items.name: dsh-session-id-for-desktop
items.desc: Adds Copy session ID and permanent deletion of a Conversation's log, projection cache and workspace references to the session row's ⋯ menu, behind a two-step confirm.

items.name: dsh-veripipe
items.desc: Keeps a per-turn receipt that later turns do not clear (final todo counts, goal id and phase, end reason, and a fail-closed pass/fail/inconclusive plan verdict), plus a read-only tool to read recent receipts. Stores counts and ids only.

items.name: dsh-turnscope
items.desc: Per-turn file changes, per-file diffs and deterministic safety verdicts for DSH sessions, plus a preview-first rewind that refuses when the worktree has drifted since the preview.

items.name: dsh-auto-continue
items.desc: Automatically sends a "continue" prompt when a reply is cut off at the output token limit, resuming long answers without manual input; aimed at self-hosted Ollama deployments with small output caps.

items.name: dsh-compact-agents
items.desc: Model-callable compact_agents tool that force-compacts context in every live session (main session, ordinary sub-agents and AgentTeams members alike), queues busy targets and compacts them when the turn ends, reports the shadowed node count and estimated tokens per target, and ships a browser form for the trigger ratio, retained ratio, controlled-phase output budget, auto-continue budget and an end-of-turn pre-compaction ratio that compacts near the trigger line once a turn ends, so a reply no longer opens with a wait for the summarizer.

items.name: dsh-session-titler
items.desc: Adds a manual, confirm-first title generator: a header button and a session-row menu entry ask a model to summarize the whole conversation, show the proposal in an editable dialog, and rename the session only after you confirm — without registering a title provider or changing automatic titling.

items.name: dsh-prompt-enhance
items.desc: Maintained fork of dsh-prompt-enhance, brought up to DSH 0.1.7 — the plugin would not even load on current hosts (InputState.imageIds became attachmentIds, so the composer button crashed the input box; settings.get() was removed; /enhance read a session id the agent no longer exposes). Rewrites default to reasoningEffort off, which measured 252 output tokens for a draft where the model default spent 2897, and a Settings page for all 17 fields is bundled. Verified on a real 0.1.7-rc.2 host: activation, a live HTTP enhancement request, /enhance in the GUI, and the Settings page reading and persisting configuration. 204 tests.

items.name: dsh-session-explorer
items.desc: Message-level full-text search across DSH sessions via an FTS5 trigram index (user / assistant / steering / tool with per-kind filters), deduplicated results across fork/continued sessions, read-only context preview with auto-scroll to the focused message, one-click jump to the real session, and incremental/full index rebuild with health check; zh/en i18n follows the Host locale service.

items.name: dsh-session-repair
items.desc: Diagnose and safely repair corrupted DSH session history: raw zstd/JSONL validation, tool-call ID repair, single-slot pre-repair backup, restore, and an audit trail.

items.name: dsh-context-continuum
items.desc: Replaces rolling narrative summaries with an append-only session index, so early facts survive compaction verbatim and shadowed text stays retrievable by anchor.

items.name: dsh-cross-session-approval
items.desc: Cross-session task delegation for DeepSeek Harness: spawn durable top-level sessions and send them tasks, read or steer them by base62 session alias, and approve their sandbox escalation requests through an approval bridge that refuses destructive deletes.

items.name: dsh-compaction-policy
items.desc: Stops DeepSeek Harness from compacting (summarizing) your conversation far too early. Without it, compaction fires around half-full on smaller context windows; with it, compaction waits until the window is as full as you want (80% by default), settable per provider/model. It only changes when compaction happens — what a summary keeps is still DSH’s decision.

items.name: dsh-global-context
items.desc: Adds a Global Prompt tab to the conversation view: text you write there is prepended to the top of every session system prompt, and saving takes effect on the next message without a restart.

items.name: dsh-attachment-library
items.desc: Read-only attachment library: lists every image and file attachment stored on this machine, its size, and which conversations (including those in the session trash) still use it, with Show in Finder and Open in Preview.

items.name: dsh-session-trash
items.desc: Session trash: move conversations to a trash instead of deleting them, restore them, or delete them permanently after a second confirmation; a session opened in this run is hidden and moved at the next start.
